scope: Editorial and written-brief extracts only; full upstream skills remain production design authorities. User-approved workflow preferences are included separately in editorial.md and channel references.
provenance_note: Checksums describe locally installed files actually read. Observed upstream heads are recorded separately and do not assert byte equivalence with those installed files.
refresh_policy: Review upstream changes explicitly, compare affected brand profile and examples, validate language and brand separation, then version the package. Never silently import unrelated brand rules.
